properties.name: Openreach pole by the track
properties.notes: Openreach telephone pole in the hedge beside the track, with a galvanised guard at its base, a joint and drop cables. A 54 mm grey duct runs from here to Openreach's chamber MH18 by the bridge (Nat, 2026-11-06).
properties.source: Nat on site with OS Maps Locate (phone GPS), 12:54 2026-11-06: SM 89367 31176. Phone GPS was unreliable nearby this day

properties.name: Openreach duct, pole ORP01 to chamber MH18
properties.notes: Openreach's 54 mm grey duct from the pole to their chamber by the bridge (Nat, 2026-11-06; that the chamber is MH18 is assumed). ⚠️ Drawn as a straight line: the real path is not known.
properties.source: Nat (2026-11-06): ends, size and colour; path not known

properties.name: Openreach pole 17
properties.notes: Openreach telephone pole in the hedge, carrying overhead lines; number plate "17" under a blue band, and a yellow warning label (Nat, 2026-11-06).
properties.source: Nat on site with OS Maps Locate (phone GPS), 12:56 2026-11-06: SM 89305 31119. Phone GPS was unreliable nearby this day; moved by Nat in map edit mode 2026-11-06 (174.4 m)
